Speaker 1: Good morning, this is Deepti from Sahayak Wealth Advisors. How may I assist you today?
Speaker 2: Hi Deepti, I want to increase my monthly SIP in the equity fund. It is 5000 right now.
Speaker 1: Sure, I can help with that. For verification, may I have your registered mobile number and date of birth?
Speaker 2: Yes. The mobile number is 9000011234 and my date of birth is 12th March 1988.
Speaker 1: Thank you, Mr. Test. Your identity is verified. May I place you on a short hold while I check your SIP details? It will take about a minute.
Speaker 2: Okay. No problem.
Speaker 1: Thank you for holding. I can see your SIP of 5000 rupees. Would you like to increase it to 10000 from next month?
Speaker 2: Yes, 10000 from next month please.
Speaker 1: Done. Your SIP top-up request is registered and will reflect from the next installment. Please note that mutual fund investments are subject to market risks, and returns are not guaranteed.
Speaker 2: Understood. Thank you. That was quick.
Speaker 1: You are welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Speaker 2: No, that is all.
Speaker 1: Thank you for calling Sahayak Wealth Advisors. I will now transfer you to a short feedback survey. Have a great day.
